pages.text: Reads the block at a position.$(br2)You get its ID, its block state properties as text and the redstone power it receives. An unloaded chunk raises CHUNK_NOT_LOADED. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.

$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the block is$(li)result $(1)id$() STRING: the block ID, e.g. minecraft:oak_door$(li)result $(1)properties$() HASH STRING: the block states, e.g. facing is north$(li)result $(1)power$() INTEGER: the redstone power it receives, 0 to 15
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_BLOCK$(br)  PARAMETER position spot ;$(br)  RESULT id blockId$(br)  RESULT properties states$(br)  RESULT power power$()
